connector.name: Browser Gateway
connector.registryDescription: AI browser tools with Chrome CDP. Navigate, screenshot, interact. Multi-provider failover.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package browser-gateway. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the browser-gateway account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BG_TOKEN
env.description: Authentication token for gateway access (optional, only needed with remote providers)
